This drift is explicitly disclosed for the saffron/cli.py citations, which the spec says were read at commit e8f5529e and instructs the agent to find by function name rather than by line number. It is not disclosed for the CLAUDE.md citations, but in each case the named sentence is immediately adjacent and unambiguous, so no criterion or witness depends on the exact line number and nothing here would mislead a build.
